Obtain World Bank consultant contract, workload and payer; intergovernmental institution is publicly controlled, but consultant versus employee and headline treatment remain unresolved.

Confirm barrister practice cessation/suspension in 2024 and substantive workload; clarify university sessional/adjunct remuneration and continuing dates, Australian Book Review paid writing, and governance remuneration/overlap.
